paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 4.26, with a decrease of 5.75% from the prior close and 14.29% over the last 20 trading sessions. There have been 2 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

Fermi Inc. has recently selected NAES to operate its natural gas generation fleet at Project Matador, as reported by marketscreener.com and Yahoo Finance on September 28, 2026. The news articles highlight the partnership between Fermi and NAES for the operation and maintenance of the natural gas turbine fleet.

There have been 25 total filings, including 3 Form 4 filings, and recent filings include a PX14A6G form on September 11, 2026, and an 8-K form on August 31, 2026, which announced the scheduling of the company's first annual meeting of stockholders. Insider transactions were also reported on August 27 and August 18, 2026, according to Form 4 filings.
